title: Echo and Horizon
author: Yara Sandoval
blurb: Petra Kavanagh, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
